case-state.alt: A six-move sequence reaches state (2,0) from empty jugs. Edge labels give the pour, fill or empty operation.
case-state.caption: Each pair gives the litres in the 4 L and 3 L jugs, in that order.

case-heuristic.alt: Weighted graph with path S to B to A to G highlighted. Cost 6.
case-heuristic.caption: Highlighted route: S → B → A → G. Total edge cost = 6.

case-heuristic.alt: Weighted graph with path S to A to G highlighted. Cost 7.
case-heuristic.caption: Highlighted route: S → A → G. Total edge cost = 7.

case-games.alt: Left to right. The root value is 7 via C. Pruned nodes: B2, B3.
case-games.caption: Green marks the chosen branch. Dashed edges and pink nodes mark pruned branches; bounds appear where branches are cut. Internal nodes show returned values or cutoff bounds.

case-games.alt: Right to left. The root value is 7 via C. Pruned nodes: A1, A2.
case-games.caption: Green marks the chosen branch. Dashed edges and pink nodes mark pruned branches; bounds appear where branches are cut. Internal nodes show returned values or cutoff bounds.

game-levels.alt: Value backup. The root value is 6 via R. Every leaf is shown.
game-levels.caption: Green marks the chosen branch. Each internal node shows its backed-up value.

game-skip.alt: Left-to-right cutoffs. The root value is 6 via A. Pruned nodes: B2, B3.
game-skip.caption: Green marks the chosen branch. Dashed edges and pink nodes mark pruned branches; bounds appear where branches are cut. Internal nodes show returned values or cutoff bounds.

case-trees.alt: Split B has weighted Gini one third, lower than Split A at 0.375. Child weights are shown.
case-trees.caption: The two children of Split B contribute 0 and (12/16)(4/9), for a total of 1/3.

case-neighbors.alt: All four points touch the margin. The solid green line is the decision boundary and the circled points are support vectors. Margin width 4.
case-neighbors.caption: Decision line x₁ = 2, margin lines x₁ = 0 and 4. Multiplying both w and b by 3 leaves the geometry unchanged.

case-neural.alt: Two ReLU hidden units feed the output. Only the first hidden bias changes because the second activation is zero.
case-neural.caption: Forward pass is top to bottom. The nonzero error signal follows the highlighted connection back to h₁.

case-cnn.alt: Four input and output shapes with a total of 1,244 trainable parameters.
case-cnn.caption: Read each shape as height × width × channels. The two convolutions contribute 368 + 876 = 1,244 parameters.

case-generalization.alt: Keep the epoch-3 checkpoint. Training and held-out curves are labelled. The chosen setting is 3 on the horizontal axis.
case-generalization.caption: Validation loss is lowest at epoch 3. Training loss keeps falling as validation loss rises.

case-clustering.alt: Number line with points shown as circles or squares by cluster and centroid locations indicated by stars.
case-clustering.caption: The dashed marker is the assignment midpoint. In round 2 the tie at 3 goes to the smaller centroid.

case-clustering.alt: Single linkage gives the same groups. Leaves are labelled and every join is annotated with its linkage height.
case-clustering.caption: Cut above height 2 to keep the groups {0, 2, 3} and {9, 10}.

kmeans-update-d.alt: Number line with points shown as circles or squares by cluster and centroid locations indicated by stars.
kmeans-update-d.caption: Point 4 ties at the old midpoint and joins the left cluster. The larger updated mean is 9.

case-pca.alt: The original point is connected by a perpendicular line to its reconstruction on the first component.
case-pca.caption: After adding the mean back, the reconstruction is (3, 4). The squared residual length is 2.

pca-proj-d.alt: The original point is connected by a perpendicular line to its reconstruction on the first component.
pca-proj-d.caption: Project to (6/5, 8/5). The residual is (4/5, −3/5), with squared length 1.

case-regression.alt: Observed points with the OLS line y = 1.2x + 0.7. Vertical dotted lines are regression residuals.
case-regression.caption: OLS minimizes the sum of squared vertical residuals. The PCA direction goes through the same sample mean but minimizes perpendicular distances.

ols-slope-d.alt: Observed points with the OLS line y = 2.2x + 0.5. Vertical dotted lines are regression residuals.
ols-slope-d.caption: OLS minimizes the sum of squared vertical residuals. The fitted line passes through the sample mean.

knn-dist.alt: Right triangle with horizontal leg 3 and vertical leg 4. Squared diagonal length 25.
knn-dist.caption: The squared Euclidean distance is 3² + 4² = 25.

fp-branch.alt: One branch, eight suffix patterns. Each node shows the item and the count accumulated along that prefix.
fp-branch.caption: Each of the 8 subsets of {A, B, C} can be combined with X (including the empty prefix).
